# Validation evidence (HACK-014)

**Start with `summary.md`** (and `headline.csv`): the out-of-sample results for the paper and the jury, generated by
`python -m stuffplus.validation.summary` directly from the CSVs below; no number is typed by hand.

| Folder / file | Data | Settings | What it holds |
|---|---|---|---|
| `summary.md`, `headline.csv` | real | mixed, labelled per row | skill vs the rubric's null model for Stuff+/Location+/Pitching+ on every split, altitude-bias test, stability |
| `official_full/` | real (627,602 rows) | production (Pitching+ inner 3-fold combination) | season holdout (2024–25 → 2026) and park holdout (No + Medium → Extreme); `altitude_bias.csv`; `acceptance_complete: true` |
| `official_fast/` | real | fast (few trees; conservative) | all 23 splits incl. 20 leave-one-park-out, physics ablations, year-to-year and sample stability |
| `demo/` | synthetic | fast | smoke evidence from the synthetic fixture only; never cite it |
| pitcher 5-fold, production | real | production | lives with each model: `reports/stuff_model/`, `reports/location_model/`, `reports/pitching_model/` (same folds, seed 2240) |

Commands (real data in the main checkout's git-ignored `data/raw/`):

```sh
python -m analysis.validation.run --splits holdouts --pitching-inner-k 3 --out reports/validation/official_full
python -m analysis.validation.run --fast --out reports/validation/official_fast
python -m stuffplus.validation.summary
```

All evidence keeps the label `exploratory_transductive`: pitch identity, per-game air density, arsenal references and
the LMB run values are prepared once on all data before the splits (no pitch's own outcome is ever a feature of that
pitch; every model and the count baseline are fit on training rows only). This is a disclosed limitation in the paper,
not a reason to treat the production runs as incomplete. Park ids are franchises inferred by HACK-003.
